From: John Lowe <johnlowe86@gmail.com>
Sent: Monday, October 27, 2014 6:02 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: this week 
 
I presume you mean early evening, like 6 or 7? That would be ideal.

On Mon, Oct 27, 2014 at 5:04 PM, Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com> wrote:
I work tomorrow day and then Wednesday-through-Sunday nights.
Maybe Wednesday evening I could stop by before work?

From: John Lowe <johnlowe86@gmail.com>
Sent: Monday, October 27, 2014 1:16 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: this week 
 
Anthony,
What is your schedule this week please? I have a bunch of books I'd like to give to you.

From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Monday, October 1, 2018 5:48 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Cc: Sulonen, Dana <DSulonen@freepress.com>; Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>
Subject: This week 
 
Noticed your phone was off (or died?). Hope all is OK.
First: Nice job on the two Tigers stories to close the season. I thought they were both good in their own ways.

As for this week: I’d like you to have grades done by Wednesday morning. You can work on them on Tuesday. We’ll push them back if news breaks. We’ll publish them online Wednesday, and run them in print on Sunday.
When do you want to run the past Tigers story? The one you went to Cleveland for? Is that also for Sunday?
Beyond that, plan to look at who the Tigers could chase in free agency. That could be a listicle or a column. Sort of a “who’s the next Mike Fiers” piece.
I also think a postseason prospect ranking would be good to have over the next week or so. ... and maybe set the early odds on who the Tigers will pick at No. 5 in another post?
Let’s talk it out whenever you’re free so we can hash it out. Would love to hear any ideas you may have, as well.
